name: How can I prevent future drain emergencies after a professional cleaning?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent future drain emergencies after a professional cleaning?

acceptedAnswer.text: After an emergency drain cleaning, you can prevent future blockages by adopting good habits. Avoid pouring grease down drains, use drain screens to catch hair and food particles, and dispose of non-biodegradable items in the trash. Consider scheduling annual drain maintenance or camera inspections, especially if you have an older plumbing system or frequently experience slow drains. Regular preventative measures can significantly reduce the risk of another emergency and extend the life of your plumbing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent future drain emergencies by avoiding grease, using drain screens, not flushing non-biodegradables, and considering annual professional maintenance.
